title: Stage 5.1 Official Output Contract & Center-Crop Baseline

scope.goal: Convert Frozen Retrieval v0 temporal segments into official-format per-frame predictions with a deterministic center-crop spatial baseline, an independent validator, and a frozen output contract for Stage 5.2-5.5.
in_scope: synthetic regression and official sample schema smoke
out_of_scope: any modification of Frozen Retrieval v0

temporal_source.name: Frozen Retrieval v0
temporal_source.binding: Stage 4.5/4.6 closure: Temporal mainline = Frozen Retrieval v0 + No Selection (SEL-3 optional frozen prune, NOT enabled) + No BR-1 + No DTL-1.

sources: Official competition brief PDF (基于视频大模型的通用视频高光剪辑, AIC 算法挑战赛)
Official baseline kit README + baseline_center.py + test_index.json + predictions.jsonl (organizer lab repo mirror, local copy)

audit_findings.frame_semantics: frame is the original global frame index; official kit sample uses 0-based indices (frame 0 present); constraint frame >= 0 and < total frame count; total frame count read by evaluator from the original video
audit_findings.bbox_type: integers in source pixels per official baseline kit README ('three ints in source pixels'); official kit baseline emits ints; competition brief example uses ints
audit_findings.height: never submitted; evaluator derives h = w * target_h / target_w
audit_findings.duplicate_frames: only the first valid prediction per frame counts for IoU; further duplicates count as false positives; writer must therefore dedup and validator must reject duplicates
audit_findings.ordering: ascending by frame officially recommended (not mandatory); this project freezes ascending as mandatory
audit_findings.empty_predictions: allowed and required as a line per video with "predictions": [] when no highlight; no fabrication of frames to avoid empties
audit_findings.video_coverage: one line per video covering every index entry (official kit README)
audit_findings.out_of_bounds: after [x,y,w] -> [x,y,w,h] conversion the box must stay inside the original frame; x >= 0, y >= 0, w > 0
audit_findings.invalid_prediction_triggers: missing fields, unmatched video_id, frame out of bounds, coordinate out of bounds, NaN, empty box, derived-height overflow
audit_findings.metric: per-video IoU-weighted F (N_gt=0 and N_pred=0 -> F=1; else P=S_IoU/N_pred, R=S_IoU/N_gt, F=2PR/(P+R)); final score = mean over videos; exact video_id+frame matching
audit_findings.gt_frame_density: train.jsonl cropRois covers every integer frame inside GT segments (dense); official test GT structure is UNKNOWN_FROM_AVAILABLE_PUBLIC_DATA

unknowns.evaluator_int_vs_float_tolerance: evaluator code not public; contract frozen to integers because the official kit README demands ints and ints are safe under both interpretations
unknowns.official_sample_videos: not present in the local baseline kit copy (video/ folder not shipped); metadata-dependent smoke therefore limited to schema-level checks

frame_projection_contract.frame_indexing: 0-based global frame index; valid range [0, frame_count)

canonical_timestamp.CFR_FPS: t(frame) = frame / fps, compared in exact rational arithmetic (Fraction); fps interpreted as its shortest decimal representation
canonical_timestamp.PTS_TABLE: t(frame) = canonical PTS of that frame from ffprobe frame scan; compared exactly via Fraction of the decimal pts_time strings
canonical_timestamp.membership: frame belongs to segment [start_sec, end_sec) iff start_sec <= t(frame) < end_sec (half-open, prevents shared boundary frames between adjacent segments)
canonical_timestamp.segment_bound_interpretation: segment bounds are floats from the frozen replay; interpreted as their shortest decimal round-trip representation before exact rational comparison

mode_selection.CFR_FPS: default; requires r_frame_rate == avg_frame_rate (exact rational equality) from ffprobe
mode_selection.PTS_TABLE: fallback for VFR sources; requires a full frame PTS table; never trusts CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC

frame_projection_contract.dedup_policy: union of per-segment frames, deduplicated by frame id, emitted strictly ascending
frame_projection_contract.beyond_video_end_policy: default clip to [0, frame_count); strict mode raises; fully-beyond segments project to zero frames; frozen segments are never edited
frame_projection_contract.empty_projection_policy: zero-duration or inverted segments project to zero frames; videos with no frozen segments emit an empty predictions line

target_ratio_contract.source: official test index field targetRatioWH = [target_w, target_h]; official sample kit contains both [16,9] and [9,16]
target_ratio_contract.height_derivation: h = w * target_h / target_w, computed by the evaluator, never emitted

center_crop_formula.name: largest target-ratio centered rectangle
center_crop_formula.exact_rational_math: all comparisons in Fraction arithmetic; no float decisions
center_crop_formula.rule: if W/H >= tw/th then crop_w = floor(H * tw / th), crop_h = H; else crop_w = W, crop_h = floor(W * th / tw) (centering only); x = floor((W - crop_w) / 2), y = floor((H - crop_h) / 2)
center_crop_formula.infeasible_geometry: raise when floor(H * tw / th) < 1 (no width >= 1 crop can satisfy the derived-height bound); never emit an invalid box

rounding_policy.constrained_dimension: floor (guarantees derived h = w * target_h / target_w <= H and x + w <= W, y + h <= H without any evaluator-side flooring assumption)
rounding_policy.deviation_from_official_baseline: official baseline_center.py uses round-half-even sizing (round(H * tw / th)); for 1920x1080 -> [9,16] that yields w=608 and derived h=1080.888 > 1080, which the competition brief classifies as an invalid out-of-bounds prediction. This protocol floors the constrained dimension (w=607, derived h=1079.111 <= 1080).
rounding_policy.no_ad_hoc_rounding: floor/round/ceil selection is frozen here; later stages must not change it without a new protocol

duplicate_frame_policy: writer rejects duplicate frames; validator counts duplicate_frame_count; target 0
ordering_policy: writer rejects non-ascending predictions; validator flags non_ascending_order; target 0 violations
empty_prediction_policy: empty predictions are legal output for videos with no frozen temporal segments; fabricating frames is forbidden

output_schema.file: JSONL, UTF-8, LF newlines, one line per index entry, index order

line.video_id: string, copied verbatim from the official index
line.targetRatioWH: [target_w, target_h] copied from the official index (official kit sample emits it per line)
line.predictions: array of {"frame": int, "bboxes": [int, int, int]}; [] allowed

output_schema.determinism: canonical json.dumps (ensure_ascii=False, default separators, insertion order), byte-identical across repeated runs

metadata_cache.provenance: r_frame_rate / avg_frame_rate recorded verbatim; selected rate recorded
metadata_cache.cpu_policy: ffprobe metadata only; no pixel decode, no PNG/JPEG extraction

validator.independence: re-implements all checks; does not trust writer internals; shares only the frozen projection contract for temporal traceability recomputation
checks: JSONL structure and per-line object shape
video_id present, non-empty, matched against index when provided
bboxes shape [x, y, w], strict ints, finite by construction, x >= 0, y >= 0, w > 0
derived h = w * target_h / target_w <= H - y via exact rational compare (with metadata + ratio)
targetRatioWH valid and consistent with index
temporal traceability: every frame must lie in the frozen-segment allow-list (recomputed)
every index entry has exactly one line
validator.gate: for a PASS, all violation counts must be 0 and issues empty

evaluation_policy.contract_metrics: Stage 5.1 reports only contract/engineering stats; target all-zero violations
evaluation_policy.spatial_gt: no official spatial GT available locally; no invented approximate official score; train.jsonl spatial fields remain excluded from model selection
evaluation_policy.sample_smoke: official kit predictions.jsonl validated in schema-only mode; tagged SAMPLE_SMOKE / NOT_FOR_MODEL_SELECTION

gates.synthetic_regression: validator PASS on all synthetic configs; byte-identical output across two runs
gates.full_test_suite: no new failures versus the Stage 4.6 recorded baseline (182 passed / 3 allowlisted failures / 3 skipped)

next_stage_handoff: Stage 5.2 Subject-Aware Spatial Localization builds on this frozen output contract; the contract files must not change without a new preregistered protocol.
